findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: The attacker can inject a file name that contains a shell metacharacter or a command, leading to OS command injection.
findings.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the input file name, and the environment where the program runs allows for shell metacharacters in file paths.

findings.title: Path Traversal
findings.trigger: The attacker can provide a file name that navigates to arbitrary files on the system, leading to path traversal.
findings.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the input file name, allowing the attacker to provide relative paths or directory traversal sequences.

findings.title: Integer Overflow
findings.untrusted_source: The edge count in the graph
findings.trigger: If the graph has a very large number of edges, the internal representation of the graph may overflow, leading to undefined behavior.
findings.assumptions: The `vertex` class does not handle edge counts safely and may overflow or underflow.

findings.title: Improper Input Validation
findings.trigger: The attacker can provide malformed input, such as empty strings or special characters, which may lead to unexpected behavior or crashes.
findings.assumptions: The program does not validate the input data before processing it.
